name: Minotaur
subtitle: Labyrinth Beast
description: Gore, Stun and Rampage your way through Battle as you stop your foes escaping the Maze!
lore: This brutal creature, half-bull and half-man, once stalked the corridors of a great labyrinth constructed at the behest of King Minos. Now set free in the chaos of the Shattering, it roams the Realm of Olympus at will, cunning enough to study its new environment in secrecy, bloodthirsty enough to kill whenever a sufficiently safe opportunity presents itself.

skills.name: Mess with the Bull, Get the Horns
skills.description: Remove a random [Disable] from this hero and place [mechanic:stalwart] and [mechanic:retaliate] for 2 turns on this hero.

skills.name: Gore
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy (7%HP+150%ATK) with a 35% chance to place 1 stack of [mechanic:bleed]. If this hero is under a [mechanic:stalwart] buff, has a chance to place 2 stacks of [mechanic:bleed] instead.

skills.name: Locked Horns
skills.description: Attack (6%HP+50%ATK)3 times at random with a 25% chance to place [mechanic:stun] for 1 turn.

skills.description: Increase the chance to strong hit by 20% while at full Divinity.
